item.title: SF-based home insurer Stand, which uses digital twins of homes to price wildfire risk and insures $10B+ of property, raised a $70M Series C at a $1B valuation (Nick Lichtenberg/Fortune)
item.description:
Nick Lichtenberg / Fortune:
SF-based home insurer Stand, which uses digital twins of homes to price wildfire risk and insures $10B+ of property, raised a $70M Series C at a $1B valuation  —  Matt DiStefano shares his screen and rotates a gray 3D model of a California neighborhood.  He zooms in on one house and overlays a heat map.

Original: https://fortune.com/2026/10/15/stand-insurance-wildfire-unicorn-raises-70-million-1-billion-valuation/

item.title: Sources: Nscale faces investor pushback on its ~$30B IPO valuation, with some urging a lower valuation of $16B to $19B, as Microsoft exits a UK data center deal (Bailey Lipschultz/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bailey Lipschultz / Bloomberg:
Sources: Nscale faces investor pushback on its ~$30B IPO valuation, with some urging a lower valuation of $16B to $19B, as Microsoft exits a UK data center deal  —  Nscale Ltd. is facing opposition to the valuation target it's pursuing in its initial public offering, according to people familiar …

Original: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-18/ai-cloud-firm-nscale-faces-investor-pushback-over-ipo-valuation

item.title: Sources: industry execs expect only 7-10 of hundreds of neoclouds to survive, as Nvidia supports them with easier credit terms, site finding, and $20B in leases (Phoebe Liu/The Information)
item.description:
Phoebe Liu / The Information:
Sources: industry execs expect only 7-10 of hundreds of neoclouds to survive, as Nvidia supports them with easier credit terms, site finding, and $20B in leases  —  How many young AI cloud providers can the market, and Nvidia, support?  —  That's one of the big questions after a week …

item.title: Anthropic says it's committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, for a total of ~20% with co-founder and staff pledges, plus 2% per 50% valuation rise (Anthropic)
item.description:
Anthropic:
Anthropic says it's committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, for a total of ~20% with co-founder and staff pledges, plus 2% per 50% valuation rise  —  Today, we're committing a portion of Anthropic's shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

Original: https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund
